description: Benchmark links Russ picked on 2026-07-30. Every extraction pipeline change is measured against these ten before it ships.

entries.notes: marry me chicken, long-form blog with story preamble

entries.text: MANGO STICKY RICE. Ingredients: 2 cups cooked sticky rice, 1 cup coconut milk, 1/4 cup sugar, pinch of salt, 1 ripe mango sliced, sesame seeds. Method: warm the coconut milk with sugar and salt. Pour over the rice. Let sit 20 min. Plate with the mango and sprinkle sesame.
entries.notes: regression: reported 2026-07-31. The source calls the rice 'cooked', so the card must still teach soaking and steaming the rice rather than accepting a prepped component. Card must contain an operation that cooks the rice.

entries.text: Weeknight chicken and rice bowl: 2 cups cooked jasmine rice, 1 lb shredded rotisserie chicken, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 scallions sliced, 1 tsp chili crisp. Toss everything together and serve warm.
entries.notes: regression: two prepped components in one source (cooked rice, shredded rotisserie chicken). The card must teach both, or flag them, rather than assuming a stocked fridge.
